title.en: A Claude Code harness with memory, specs, and skills
title.zh: 替 Claude Code 加上記憶、規格與 skill 的工具組

description.en: Clawd-Lobster wraps the Claude Code CLI with a per-workspace MCP memory server, a four-role Spec Squad built on the Claude Agent SDK, eleven skill manifests, and scheduled git sync across machines. Experimental: built in April 2026, with a security and cleanup pass in October 2026.
description.zh: Clawd-Lobster 在 Claude Code CLI 外圍加上每個工作區各一份的 MCP 記憶伺服器、以 Claude Agent SDK 打造的四角色 Spec Squad、11 個 skill 資訊清單，以及跨機器的排程 git 同步。屬實驗性質：2026 年 4 月寫成，2026 年 10 月做過一次安全與整理修正。

headline.en: A memory and a reviewer for Claude Code.
headline.zh:
給 Claude Code 一份記憶，
再加一位審查者。

lede.en: Each workspace gets its own SQLite memory over MCP. Before any code is written, an Architect session drafts a spec and a separate Reviewer session challenges it. Scheduled jobs carry what was learned to your other machines through git.
lede.zh: 每個工作區都有自己的 SQLite 記憶，透過 MCP 存取。動手寫程式之前，Architect session 先起草規格，再由另一個獨立的 Reviewer session 挑毛病。排程工作再透過 git，把累積的知識帶到你的其他機器。

notes.zh: 實驗性質 · 最後提交於 2026 年 4 月

lines.text: Describe your project (press Enter twice to finish):

text.en: A to-do REST API for a small team. FastAPI, SQLite, token auth.
text.zh: 給小團隊用的待辦事項 REST API，FastAPI 加 SQLite，要有 token 驗證。

lines.text: Spec complete: 4 turns, 2 review rounds, approved=True

label.zh: 套件版本，2026 年 4 月

label.en: MCP tools in the memory server
label.zh: 記憶伺服器的 MCP 工具
skill 資訊清單，分成四類

label.en: Spec Squad roles, a fresh session per turn
label.zh: Spec Squad 角色，每一輪都是新的 session

title.en: Context gets lost between sessions and machines.
title.zh:
換了對話、換了機器，
脈絡就斷了。

body.en: Decisions, open TODOs, and lessons from failed attempts end up scattered across chat logs and one long CLAUDE.md, and each machine keeps its own copy. A spec written and approved by the same session carries its gaps straight into the code. Clawd-Lobster gives each workspace a structured memory, syncs it through git, and puts a separate reviewer between the spec and the build.
body.zh: 決策、還沒做完的 TODO、失敗過的嘗試，最後散落在對話紀錄和一份越寫越長的 CLAUDE.md 裡，每台機器還各有一份。由同一個 session 撰寫又自己核准的規格，會把漏洞原封不動帶進程式碼。Clawd-Lobster 讓每個工作區有結構化的記憶，透過 git 同步，並在規格與實作之間安排一位獨立的審查者。

quote.en: The Reviewer never sees the Architect's instructions. It gets the spec files and read-only tools, and its only job is to find what is wrong.
quote.zh:
Reviewer 看不到 Architect 的指示，
只有規格和唯讀工具，
它的工作就是找出問題。

title.en: Set up once. Then every project runs the same loop.
title.zh:
設定一次，
之後照流程走。

intro.en: The browser and the terminal drive the same engine, and every step leaves files in the workspace that you can open and read.
intro.zh: 瀏覽器和終端機驅動的是同一套引擎，每一步都會在工作區留下檔案，隨時可以打開來看。

body.en: clawd-lobster serve opens a setup wizard on localhost:3333: language, Claude sign-in, a private GitHub Hub, the workspace root, then each required skill. The install scripts cover similar ground from a terminal.
body.zh: clawd-lobster serve 會在 localhost:3333 打開設定精靈：語言、Claude 登入、私人的 GitHub Hub、工作區根目錄，接著逐一設定必要的 skill。安裝腳本則在終端機完成類似的設定。

body.en: In the browser, a discovery chat asks follow-up questions until it has enough to start. In the terminal you type the description and press Enter twice.
body.zh: 在瀏覽器裡，探索對話會一直追問，直到資訊足夠才開始。在終端機則是直接輸入描述，按兩次 Enter 結束。

body.en: The Architect writes OpenSpec files with SHALL/MUST requirements and Gherkin scenarios. The Reviewer challenges them for up to five rounds, the Coder builds from tasks.md, and the Tester checks each requirement. Terminal mode asks before building.
body.zh: Architect 寫出 OpenSpec 檔案，需求用 SHALL/MUST 描述並附上 Gherkin 情境。Reviewer 最多挑戰五輪，接著 Coder 依 tasks.md 實作，Tester 逐條檢查需求。終端機模式在開始實作前會先問你。

body.en: Decisions, TODOs, and an action log go into a SQLite file in each workspace. With the install scripts, a job every 30 minutes pulls, commits, and pushes the repositories under the workspace root.
body.zh: 決策、TODO 與操作紀錄寫進各工作區自己的 SQLite 檔。用安裝腳本安裝的話，排程工作每 30 分鐘會對工作區根目錄底下的 repo 執行 pull、commit 與 push。

title.zh:
Claude Code 不動，
只在外圍加零件。

intro.en: Each piece is a Python module, a script, or a folder of Markdown and JSON. Claude Code itself is never patched.
intro.zh: 每個零件都是一個 Python 模組、一支腳本，或是一個裝著 Markdown 與 JSON 的資料夾。Claude Code 本身完全不動。

body.en: Architect, Reviewer, Coder, and Tester each run as fresh Claude Agent SDK sessions with their own prompts and tool lists. The Reviewer can only read, and only the Coder and Tester can run shell commands.
body.zh: Architect、Reviewer、Coder、Tester 每一輪都在全新的 Claude Agent SDK session 裡執行，各有自己的 prompt 與可用工具。Reviewer 只能讀檔，只有 Coder 和 Tester 能執行 shell 指令。

body.en: A FastMCP server with 27 tools for decisions, knowledge, TODOs, learned skills, and an audit trail, stored in SQLite per workspace. Salience rises when an item is used and decays when it is not, and search ranks by it. It grew out of mcp-memory-server.
body.zh: 以 FastMCP 寫成，提供 27 個工具，記錄決策、知識、TODO、學到的 skill 與稽核軌跡，每個工作區各存一份 SQLite。項目被用到時 salience 上升，閒置時衰減，搜尋結果依此排序。前身是 mcp-memory-server。

body.en: clawd-lobster serve runs a standard-library HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 with pages for setup, workspaces, skills, credentials, and a live Squad view. The browser and a Claude Code session share one controller lease, so only one of them drives setup at a time. Every POST needs the token from that run, a local Host header, and a matching Origin.
body.zh: clawd-lobster serve 用 Python 標準函式庫在 127.0.0.1 啟動 HTTP 伺服器，提供設定、工作區、skill、憑證與即時 Squad 畫面。瀏覽器和 Claude Code session 共用一份控制權租約，同一時間只有一方能操作設定。每個 POST 都要帶這次啟動產生的 token，Host 必須是本機，Origin 也要相符。

body.en: Eleven skills in four kinds: MCP server, prompt pattern, cron job, and poller. Each skill.json declares credentials, a health check, and dependencies, plus setup steps for the six required ones; prompt patterns ship a SKILL.md for Claude to follow.
body.zh: 11 個 skill 分成四類：MCP 伺服器、prompt 模式、cron 排程與輪詢器。每個 skill.json 都寫明所需憑證、健康檢查與相依項目，六個必要的 skill 另外寫好設定步驟；prompt 模式則附一份 SKILL.md 讓 Claude 照著做。

body.en: Setup creates or joins a private GitHub repository as the Hub. The install scripts also schedule a job that pulls, commits, and pushes every repository under the workspace root every 30 minutes, so the next machine sees the same knowledge files.
body.zh: 設定流程會建立或加入一個私人 GitHub repo 當作 Hub。安裝腳本另外排了一個工作，每 30 分鐘對工作區根目錄底下的每個 repo 執行 pull、commit 與 push，另一台機器就能看到同樣的知識檔案。

body.en: Every two hours, evolve-tick asks Claude to look over finished TODOs and recent actions, stores reusable patterns as learned skills, decays stale salience, and lints the knowledge wiki. Improvement ideas are committed as proposal files for a person to review.
body.zh: evolve-tick 每兩小時請 Claude 檢視完成的 TODO 與最近的操作，把可重複使用的做法存成 learned skill，讓久未使用的項目 salience 衰減，並檢查知識 wiki。改進想法會寫成提案檔 commit 進去，等人審查。

title.zh:
設定精靈，
2026 年 4 月擷取。

intro.en: Crops of a real capture in docs/screenshots. Setup is one page: four foundation checks, then each required skill with its own steps. The wizard also comes in Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
intro.zh: 裁切自 docs/screenshots 裡的實際畫面。設定精靈只有一頁：先完成四項基礎設定，再逐一設定每個必要的 skill。介面另有繁體中文、簡體中文、日文與韓文版本。

alt.en: Clawd-Lobster setup wizard, Foundations section: language picker, Claude Code sign-in check, GitHub Hub, and workspace root
alt.zh: Clawd-Lobster 設定精靈的基礎設定區塊：語言選擇、Claude Code 登入檢查、GitHub Hub 與工作區根目錄

caption.en: Foundations: language chosen, the Claude sign-in and workspace root checks not yet passing, the Hub still pending.
caption.zh: 基礎設定：語言已選好，Claude 登入與工作區根目錄的檢查尚未通過，Hub 還沒設定。

alt.en: Required skills section listing the memory server, spec, and absorb skills with their setup steps
alt.zh: 必要 skill 區塊，列出記憶伺服器、spec 與 absorb 的設定步驟

caption.en: Required skills: each card lists its steps and stays locked until what it depends on has passed. The memory server waits for the workspace root.
caption.zh: 必要的 skill：每張卡片列出自己的設定步驟，相依項目完成前維持鎖定。記憶伺服器要等工作區根目錄設好。

title.zh:
三個外掛元件，
CLI 原封不動。

intro.en: Claude Code stays the engine. The harness talks to it through MCP, CLAUDE.md, settings.json, and the Agent SDK, and keeps its own state in files.
intro.zh: Claude Code 仍然是引擎。這套工具組透過 MCP、CLAUDE.md、settings.json 與 Agent SDK 和它溝通，自己的狀態則存在檔案裡。

label.en: Web UI → Squad → memory → Claude Code
label.zh: 儀表板 → Squad → 記憶 → Claude Code

items.en: MCP, CLAUDE.md, settings.json hooks, and the Claude Agent SDK; no patched Claude Code
items.zh: 使用 MCP、CLAUDE.md、settings.json hook 與 Claude Agent SDK，不修改 Claude Code

items.en: State lives in files you can read: SQLite, Markdown, JSON
items.zh: 狀態都存在看得懂的檔案裡：SQLite、Markdown、JSON

items.en: The installers back up CLAUDE.md before appending to it
items.zh: 安裝程式在附加內容到 CLAUDE.md 之前會先備份

items.en: Scheduling goes through cron, launchd, or Task Scheduler instead of a resident daemon
items.zh: 排程交給 cron、launchd 或工作排程器，沒有常駐程式

title.en: Wrap Claude Code, do not replace it
title.zh: 包住 Claude Code，而不是取代它

body.en: Agent loops, model calls, and tool use stay inside Claude Code and the Agent SDK. This repository only adds memory, specs, scheduling, and setup around them, so most Claude Code updates need no changes here.
body.zh: agent 迴圈、模型呼叫與工具使用都留在 Claude Code 和 Agent SDK 裡。這個 repo 只在外圍加上記憶、規格、排程與設定，所以 Claude Code 大部分的更新都不需要這裡跟著改。

title.en: Separate sessions for writing and reviewing
title.zh: 撰寫和審查分成不同的 session

body.en: The Reviewer gets its own prompt and read-only tools and never sees the Architect's instructions. The cost is time and tokens: every review round is a full session, which is why the loop stops after five rounds.
body.zh: Reviewer 有自己的 prompt 和唯讀工具，看不到 Architect 收到的指示。代價是時間與 token：每一輪審查都是一個完整的 session，所以迴圈最多只跑五輪。

title.zh: 用 git 當同步協定

body.en: Machines share knowledge through a private GitHub repository instead of a shared database. No server is needed, but sync means scheduled commits and pushes, and a merge conflict stalls that repository until someone resolves it.
body.zh: 機器之間透過私人 GitHub repo 分享知識，而不是共用資料庫。不需要另外架伺服器，代價是排程會自動 commit 與 push；遇到合併衝突時，那個 repo 的同步就會卡住，直到有人處理。

body.en: Every workspace works with a local SQLite file and plain text search. Vector search, cross-machine recall, and the Vault turn on only when you connect an Oracle database and an embedding endpoint.
body.zh: 每個工作區只要本機的 SQLite 檔案與一般文字搜尋就能運作。向量搜尋、跨機器回想與 Vault，要接上 Oracle 資料庫和 embedding 端點才會啟用。

intro.en: You need Python 3.10 or newer (3.11 for the memory server), Git, and a signed-in Claude Code CLI. A GitHub account and the gh CLI matter only for the Hub. There is no PyPI package.
intro.zh: 需要 Python 3.10 以上（記憶伺服器要 3.11）、Git，以及已登入的 Claude Code CLI。只有要用 Hub 時才需要 GitHub 帳號與 gh CLI。目前沒有 PyPI 套件。

body.en: Clone github.com/TED-H-com/clawd-lobster, then install it with the agent extra. Spec Squad needs claude-agent-sdk, which a plain pip install -e . leaves out.
body.zh: 先 clone github.com/TED-H-com/clawd-lobster，再連同 agent 這組選用相依套件一起安裝。Spec Squad 需要 claude-agent-sdk，單純 pip install -e . 不會裝。

body.en: Starts on 127.0.0.1:3333 and opens your browser at the setup wizard.
body.zh: 在 127.0.0.1:3333 啟動，並自動用瀏覽器打開設定精靈。

body.en: setup checks prerequisites, sets the workspace root, and creates a first workspace. squad start writes and reviews a spec in the current folder, then asks before building.
body.zh: setup 會檢查必要工具、設定工作區根目錄，並建立第一個工作區。squad start 在目前的資料夾撰寫並審查規格，開始實作前會先問你。

intro.en: Experimental. 136 commits between April 1 and April 9, 2026, then October 2026 fixes: the local web server was locked down, scheduling was fixed, host names are no longer written out, and the Linux sync no longer stops when a file pattern matches nothing. No tagged releases; the changelog now covers 0.6.0.
intro.zh: 實驗性質。2026 年 4 月 1 日到 9 日之間有 136 個 commit，2026 年 10 月又做了修正：鎖住本機網頁伺服器、修好排程、不再寫入主機名稱，Linux 的同步也不會再因為某種檔案類型比對不到就中止。沒有正式的 release；CHANGELOG 已補上 0.6.0。

works.en: pip install -e . gives a clawd-lobster command with serve, setup, workspace create, squad start, and status
works.zh: pip install -e . 之後就有 clawd-lobster 指令，包含 serve、setup、workspace create、squad start 與 status

works.en: 89 tests pass on Python 3.14 (onboarding, scheduling, server security, Spec Squad approval, the sync script, and PowerShell encoding), plus a scripted end-to-end run through the HTTP API
works.zh: 89 個測試在 Python 3.14 上通過（設定流程、排程、伺服器安全、Spec Squad 核准、同步腳本與 PowerShell 編碼），另有一支透過 HTTP API 跑完整流程的端對端腳本

works.en: The memory server runs on SQLite alone, with text search ranked by salience
works.zh: 記憶伺服器只靠 SQLite 就能運作，文字搜尋依 salience 排序

works.en: Install scripts for Windows (PowerShell), macOS, and Linux
works.zh: 提供 Windows（PowerShell）、macOS 與 Linux 的安裝腳本

works.en: Spec Squad in the terminal stops after the spec and asks before any code is written
works.zh: 終端機版的 Spec Squad 寫完規格會停下來，問過你才開始寫程式

limits.en: No feature work since April 9, 2026, and not checked against later Claude Code or Agent SDK releases
limits.zh: 2026 年 4 月 9 日之後沒有新功能，也沒有針對之後的 Claude Code 或 Agent SDK 版本驗證過

limits.en: If the Reviewer has not approved after five rounds, the spec still counts as approved, marked as forced by the round limit, and the web flow goes on to build
limits.zh: 審查五輪後若 Reviewer 仍未核准，規格還是會被當成已核准，只是標記為回合上限強制通過，網頁流程也會直接進入實作

limits.en: The 30-minute sync, which only the install scripts schedule, commits and pushes each git repository under the workspace root when the index has changes. It stages tracked updates and new Markdown, JSON, YAML, HTML, and script files. Other new files stay untracked, and ignored files stay ignored. Keep anything you do not want pushed outside that folder
limits.zh: 每 30 分鐘的同步（只有安裝腳本會排程）會在索引裡有變更時，對工作區根目錄底下的每個 git repo 自動 commit 並 push。已追蹤檔案的更新，以及新的 Markdown、JSON、YAML、HTML 與腳本檔會被加進去；其他新檔案維持未追蹤，被忽略的檔案也不會加進去。不想被推上去的東西請放在這個資料夾以外

limits.en: The connect-odoo poller cannot be scheduled yet: setup reports that its entrypoint is missing
limits.zh: connect-odoo 的輪詢器還不能排程，設定時會回報找不到進入點

limits.en: Heartbeat treats a session as alive when a process name matches, and revives with a plain claude --resume, which opens the session picker instead of a specific session
limits.zh: Heartbeat 只用程式名稱判斷 session 是否還在執行，重新開啟時也只是執行單純的 claude --resume，會開出 session 選單，而不是接回特定的 session

limits.en: Spec Squad needs the [agent] extra; vector search and the Vault need an Oracle database; the memory server needs Python 3.11 or newer
limits.zh: Spec Squad 需要 [agent] 選用相依套件；向量搜尋與 Vault 需要 Oracle 資料庫；記憶伺服器需要 Python 3.11 以上

value.en: Python, Claude Agent SDK, FastMCP, SQLite

intro.en: The Reviewer is a separate session. It sees the spec files, not the Architect's instructions.
intro.zh: Reviewer 是另一個 session，只看得到規格檔，看不到 Architect 收到的指示。

note.en: The Architect writes OpenSpec files with SHALL and MUST lines and Gherkin scenarios.
note.zh: Architect 寫 OpenSpec 檔，需求用 SHALL 和 MUST，附上 Gherkin 情境。

note.en: The Reviewer gets Read, Glob, and Grep. It can look, but not edit.
note.zh: Reviewer 只有 Read、Glob 和 Grep，看得到，改不了。

note.en: Reviewer approval is saved as reviewer. Five rounds without it are saved as round_limit.
note.zh: Reviewer 核准，就記成 reviewer；五輪還沒過，就記成 round_limit。

ticks.en: not approved, back to the Architect

caption.en: Every round is a fresh session, which costs time and tokens, so it stops at five. In the terminal, it asks you before writing any code.
caption.zh: 每一輪都是全新的 session，很花時間和 token，所以最多五輪。終端機模式在寫程式之前，會先問你要不要開始。

intro.en: Every skill has a skill.json that names its kind, credentials, health check, and dependencies.
intro.zh: 每個 skill 都有一份 skill.json，寫明類型、憑證、健康檢查和相依項目。

note.en: The repo ships 11 of them, and setup requires 6.
note.zh: repo 裡有 11 份，設定時有 6 個是必裝。

note.en: The kind decides how a skill runs. Setup can't find the entrypoint of connect-odoo, the only poller.
note.zh: 類型決定 skill 怎麼跑。唯一的 poller 是 connect-odoo，設定時找不到它的進入點。

ticks.en: the poller can't be scheduled yet

caption.en: Seven of the eleven are prompt patterns, each with a SKILL.md. The two cron skills, heartbeat and evolve, register their own schedule.
caption.zh: 11 個裡有 7 個是 prompt-pattern，各附一份 SKILL.md。兩個 cron 類的 heartbeat 和 evolve，會自己註冊排程。

intro.en: Both the browser and Claude Code can change setup, so each has to hold the same lease first.
intro.zh: 瀏覽器和 Claude Code 都能改設定，所以要先拿到同一份租約。

note.en: The setup page takes the lease under the name web.
note.zh: 設定頁拿租約時，名字是 web。

note.en: A Claude Code session can take it too, as claude.
note.zh: Claude Code session 也能拿，名字是 claude。

note.en: It lasts 90 seconds, and the page renews it every 25. The other side is refused.
note.zh: 有效 90 秒，設定頁每 25 秒續一次，另一邊會被擋下。

caption.en: While one side is halfway through, the other can't step in. It gets the lease only after it is released or runs out.
caption.zh: 一邊改到一半，另一邊插不了手，要等租約放掉或過期才拿得到。

intro.en: What finished work teaches is kept, and ideas for improvement are written down for a person.
intro.zh: 做完的事，學到的要留下來，想改進的先寫下來等人看。

note.en: cron, launchd, or Windows Task Scheduler starts evolve-tick, which exits when done.
note.zh: cron、launchd 或 Windows 工作排程器叫起 evolve-tick，跑完就退出。

note.en: Claude reads the recently finished TODOs and actions.
note.zh: Claude 讀最近做完的 TODO 和操作紀錄。

note.en: A pattern worth reusing becomes a learned skill.
note.zh: 值得重複用的做法，存成 learned skill。

note.en: An improvement idea becomes a Markdown file in openspec/proposals, for a person to read.
note.zh: 改進想法寫成 openspec/proposals 裡的 Markdown，等人來看。

caption.en: A proposal is only a Markdown file and never changes the code by itself. Memories older than 30 days that were never used lose 5% of their score each run, but nothing is deleted.
caption.zh: 提案只是一個 Markdown 檔，不會自己去改程式。建立超過 30 天、從沒用過的記憶，每次分數打 95 折，但不會被刪掉。

intro.en: The Reviewer only reads. Bash goes only to the Coder and the Tester.
intro.zh: Reviewer 只能讀檔，Bash 只交給 Coder 和 Tester。

note.en: The requirements in openspec, which the Reviewer may read.
note.zh: openspec 裡的需求，Reviewer 可以讀。

note.en: Its tools are Read, Glob, and Grep.
note.zh: 工具只有 Read、Glob 和 Grep。

note.en: Adds Write, Edit, and Bash, and builds from tasks.md.
note.zh: 多了 Write、Edit 和 Bash，照 tasks.md 實作。

note.en: Runs Bash for tests, but has no Write or Edit.
note.zh: 可以跑 Bash 測試，但沒有 Write 和 Edit。

caption.en: Each role runs in a fresh session. Its tools are set in code, not left to the prompt.
caption.zh: 每個角色都是新的 session，能用哪些工具寫在程式裡，不是在 prompt 裡拜託它。

heading.zh: 每台機器靠 git 同步

intro.en: No server is needed. The cost: a merge conflict stops that repo until a person fixes it.
intro.zh: 不用另外架伺服器。代價是遇到合併衝突時，那個 repo 會停下來等人處理。

note.en: A job the install scripts schedule. It runs on time and exits when done.
note.zh: 安裝腳本排好的工作，時間到就跑，跑完就結束。

note.en: Every git repo under the workspace root is pulled.
note.zh: 工作區根目錄下的每個 git repo 都會 pull。

note.en: If anything changed, it commits and pushes. New files are added only for a few text types, such as Markdown, JSON, and scripts.
note.zh: 有變更就 commit 再 push。新檔只收幾種文字檔，像 Markdown、JSON 和腳本。

ticks.zh: 每個 repo 都 pull 過
有衝突就停在那個 repo

caption.en: Ignored files, and new files outside that list, are never pushed.
caption.zh: .gitignore 擋掉的檔和清單以外的新檔，都不會推上去。
